Value.Heading: Value
Value.RangeHint: Each target and each roll gets its own value from this range, so it looks natural.

Target.Heading: Target
Target.Hint: you can pick more than one
Target.TokensHint: their players, or the NPC itself

Damage.Heading: Damage roll
Damage.TotalHint: sum of all damage parts of the attack; nearest possible value if the dice can't reach it
Damage.MaxHint: Every die in the next damage roll lands on its highest face; flat bonuses are added as usual.
Damage.MinHint: Every die in the next damage roll lands on 1; flat bonuses are added as usual.

Luck.Heading: Luck statistics
Luck.Hint: The last 20 d20s in the chat log (newest on the left; set values included). The average should be 10.5; the unluckiest is on top.
Luck.Empty: No player d20s in the chat log.
Luck.Boost: Make their next d20 land between 12 and 17

Notify.NeedsLibWrapper: Fated Rolls needs the libWrapper module.
Notify.NoTokens: No tokens are selected on the map.
Notify.NpcOnlyD20: {name} has no player: only d20s can be set for NPCs.
Notify.Mercy: Mercy: {name} rolled low {count} times in a row, their next d20 → {value}

LogToChat.Name: Log to chat
LogToChat.Hint: Every setting, cancellation and use is whispered to the GMs in chat. Players don't see it.

mercyEnabled.Name: Mercy mode
mercyEnabled.Hint: When a player rolls several low d20s in a row, their next d20 is quietly raised. The GM gets a notice.

mercyThreshold.Name: Mercy: low roll is below
mercyThreshold.Hint: A natural d20 under this number counts as a low roll.

mercyStreak.Name: Mercy: low rolls in a row
mercyStreak.Hint: How many low rolls in a row before mercy steps in.

Warning.Title: Fated Rolls
Warning.Text:
Before you use it! You are a Gamemaster, the entire burden of existence rests on your shoulders. The power of fate is a corrupting force! Use it with caution.
- Durukan (mayflower)

Panic.Title: Panic Roll!
Panic.Hint: one click: the next d20 becomes this value
